description: Search Twitch, fetch top live streams, browse categories and category VODs, or look up channels, videos, and clips by ID or URL. No Twitch login is required.

categorySlug.description: Category slug (`just-chatting`), exact name (`Just Chatting`), or directory URL.
categorySlug.title: Category slug, name, or URL (mode=byCategory, byCategoryVideos, topClips)

channelName.description: Twitch channel login or channel URL, e.g. `lirik` or `https://www.twitch.tv/lirik`.
channelName.title: Channel login (mode=byChannel)

channelNames.description: Batch channel logins or channel URLs. Duplicates and the single `channelName` are merged.
channelNames.title: Channel logins or URLs (mode=byChannel)

clipPeriod.description: Time window over which clips were created.
clipPeriod.title: Clip time window

clipSlug.description: Twitch clip slug or clip URL, e.g. `AcceptablePleasantAuberginePanicVis-EVdxDQ1vsQAQZpBS`.
clipSlug.title: Clip slug (mode=byClip)

clipSlugs.description: Batch clip slugs or clip URLs. Duplicates and the single `clipSlug` are merged.
clipSlugs.title: Clip slugs or URLs (mode=byClip)

clipSort.description: Sort clips by views or trending score.
clipSort.title: Clip order

containsKeyword.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on stream, VOD, and clip titles.
containsKeyword.title: Title contains keyword

includeChannelClips.description: Also fetch and emit top clips for each channel.
includeChannelClips.title: Include clips (mode=byChannel)

includeChannelVideos.description: Also fetch and emit recent VODs for each channel.
includeChannelVideos.title: Include VODs (mode=byChannel)

language.description: Filter live streams, VODs, and clips to one broadcast language. Leave on `(any)` for no filter.
language.title: Broadcast language

maxFollowersCount.description: Drop channels and live streams above this follower count. Useful for finding smaller creators.
maxFollowersCount.title: Maximum followers

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Twitch source caps still apply (e.g. about 1,000 clips per category).
maxItems.title: Max items

minFollowersCount.description: Drop channels and live streams below this follower count. VODs and clips are unaffected.
minFollowersCount.title: Minimum followers

minViewCount.description: Drop VODs and clips below this total view count.
minViewCount.title: Minimum total views

minViewersCount.description: Drop live streams (and categories) below this viewer count.
minViewersCount.title: Minimum concurrent viewers

enumTitles: Channel info + recent VODs + clips + schedule
mode.title: Mode

onlyLive.description: Drop channel profile records for channels that are not live right now. Their VODs and clips are still returned.
onlyLive.title: Only live channels

searchQuery.description: Free-text query for `mode=search` — matches channels, categories, and videos.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

searchType.description: Restrict search results to one index. `all` returns channels, categories, and videos.
searchType.title: Search result type (mode=search)

streamSort.description: Sort live streams by viewers (high to low or low to high), recently started, or recommended.
streamSort.title: Live stream order

streamTags.description: Only live streams carrying all of these freeform tags, e.g. `English`, `DropsEnabled`, `NoBackseating`.
streamTags.title: Stream tags

streamType.description: Restrict channel or category VODs to one broadcast type. Leave blank for all types.
streamType.title: VOD type

twitchUrls.description: Channel, VOD, clip, or category URLs. Category and channel `/videos` and `/clips` tabs are supported.
twitchUrls.title: Twitch URLs (mode=byUrl)

videoId.description: Twitch VOD ID or VOD URL, e.g. `2766365638`.
videoId.title: Video ID (mode=byVideo)

videoIds.description: Batch VOD IDs or VOD URLs. Duplicates and the single `videoId` are merged.
videoIds.title: Video IDs or URLs (mode=byVideo)

videoSort.description: Sort channel or category VODs by publish time or view count.
videoSort.title: VOD order

title: Twitch Scraper Input
